notes.title: Hot Rod Mayhem Coming to Steam this Summer!
notes.content:
Hello Champions! 

We come with exciting news! 

We are happy to share that [b]Hot Rod Mayhem is releasing on PC this summer![/b] Check out the demo today on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062040/Hot_Rod_Mayhem/]Steam[/url] or, if you prefer console you can play the full release now on

We believe Hot Rod Mayhem is a wonder to play with friends up to 4 players in split screen, and we think this is going to bring joy to lots of friends all over the world.

 We hope to connect with you by bringing our unique take with Hot Rod Mayhem! Feel free to share the love on social media or get in touch with our community [url=https://discord.gg/GktUjgmCa2]Discord[/url].
